video_caption: The video begins with a dark screen featuring small, dissolving black squares, followed by white text appearing briefly: "sustain," and then "start" on two grey squares. The screen then turns black before the "wamda" logo appears in white with a green star-filled square, and the tagline "inspire. empower. connect." in smaller white text. This transitions to a title card with the "wamda" logo in the top left, a dark grey background with scattered green stars, and a central green rectangle displaying white text: "Wayne Borg," "COO, twofour54," "UAE," and below the rectangle, "Talking to Wamda's Eddie Taylor." The scene then shifts to two men seated on a dark stage with a green star pattern. The man on the left, wearing a light blue shirt and a white lanyard, speaks into a headset microphone, gesturing towards the man on the right. The man on the right, wearing a black jacket over a grey collared shirt, listens intently. Close-ups alternate between the man in the black jacket, who is later shown holding a microphone, and the man in the light blue shirt, who speaks animatedly, using hand gestures.

The camera alternates between close-up shots of the speaker and wider shots showing both individuals.
